commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

50' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
44' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

39' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

19' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised.
16' 1 - 1 Goal! Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.

14' Rayo Vallecano are seeing far more of the ball now.
